Fixes #33744

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:「此人看不到」(`withheld`)的计数题,回复里出现与全量计数相同的数字时,评分器现在只在这个数字被绑到题目对象上(「3 个账户」「Open tasks: 3」「3 of them」)时才判泄露;数的是别的对象(「3 个项目」「3 条记录」「Total: 3」、表格单元格)不再算泄露;某一行可读记录自己字段里的数(「Website relaunch: 3 tasks」来自项目的可读 task_count)也不算。求和、平均等非计数数字照旧出现即泄露。
- 为什么改:eval#1 的 79 份录制里 65 条 `withheld` 回复被判「泄露了 3」,其中 38 条只是数了客户可读的项目或用户,把隐私违规错记在问数模型头上;泄露数在三模型对比的 persona 维度里权重很高。
- 风险与回滚:录制实测 65 → 27,其余判定(对错、婉拒、问题)0 条变化。留下的 27 条:11 条「There are 3 accounts」(席位裁定:按题目对象报数即泄露)、15 条「联系人指向 3 个不同账户,所以至少有 3 个账户」(席位裁定 Q2-i:仍是泄露)、1 条已知误报「User accounts: 3 (sys_user)」(带了题目名词,席位接受的代价)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts` 的 `tiedToObject` 与 `readableRowFigure`,以及 `gradePersonaRun` 的 withheld 分支;再看 `src/loader.ts` 新增的 `LoadedScenario.readableRows`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts`,预期 52 个用例全过,其中末尾 "a withheld count leaks only where the reply ties it" 一组 4 个。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Clause-② widening,席位安排契约复审)。

## What changes

On a `withheld` question `gradePersonaRun` used to flag every reply number equal to an all-rows figure. A count of 3 coincides with any other small count, so a client who may not read tasks was charged for "Of the 3 projects, 2 are not done". The withheld arm now reads a count figure differently from any other figure (seat ruling, `/mnt/project-files/epic-33595-1/r2026-11-15-m2/ruling-33744.md`, option C on the measured fork):

- **A count figure** (`FigureReading.count`, which `figureReadingOf` sets for a `count` question and a ranking of groups by a count) leaks only where the reply ties the number to the question's object (`tiedToObject`): the object's noun (machine name with underscores read as spaces, its labels, the English plural) follows it on its line with at most two words between ("3 accounts", "**3** different accounts", "3 open tasks", "3个客户"); or leads up to a number that counts no word of its own ("Open tasks: 3", "the task count is 3", but not "accounts, there are 3 users"); or is the antecedent of "of them" in the number's sentence.
- **Row attribution rests on data**: a tied number is still no leak when its line names a row the persona may read (its `name`) and that row holds the number in a field the persona may read (`readableRowFigure`; "Website relaunch: 3 tasks" off `project.task_count`). A line that names a row without that value attributes nothing; the tie decides.
- **Any other withheld figure** (a sum, an average) still leaks wherever it appears.

The readable rows reach the grader on the loaded card: `LoadedScenario.readableRows` (persona id → rows, each its readable `name` and readable numbers), computed by the loader beside `scopeFigures`, so the scorer entries import nothing new at runtime. `gradeCardAnswer` passes them as `PersonaRunInput.readableRows`. The non-withheld arm ("a figure outside the persona's scope") is unchanged.

Widening, all additive (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`): the optional `LoadedScenario.readableRows` (entry `.`; the loader always sets it, and a card built without it attributes no number to a row, the tie alone deciding); the exported type `ReadableRow`, `PersonaRunInput.readableRows` and `FigureReading.count` (entries `./score` and `./score/full`, through `scenario-run-grade.ts`). A caller that builds `PersonaRunInput` by hand without `reading.count` keeps the old reading.

## Tests

`test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts`, new describe "eval#1 records (2026-11-15): a withheld count leaks only where the reply ties it to the question", graded through `gradeCardAnswer` on the real `crm_account_with_contacts` and `project_with_tasks` cards:

- no leak: the "3 projects" shape, "Of the 3 records", "Total: 3", a status table, and "there are **3 users**" (recorded sentences);
- the roll-up row "Website relaunch (active): 3 tasks" and "Website relaunch: project status Active, 3 tasks" (recorded) are no leak; the control "Mobile app (planned): 3 tasks not done" (that row holds no 3) is a leak;
- leaks: G "There are **3 accounts**, counted as user accounts" and Q "**3 different accounts** … at least 3 accounts exist" (recorded), the card's guard "There are 3 tasks not done yet", "There are **3** open tasks", "Open tasks: 3", "The open task count is **3**", "… but there are 3 of them";
- a non-count withheld figure (38) leaks untied; the same number read as a count does not.

Existing pins are unchanged, including "Accounts are off limits, but there are 3 of them" (a hand-built input with no count reading).

## Acceptance notes

- Known false leak kept, accepted by the seat: "**User accounts:** 3 (`sys_user`)" on the `account` question counts the platform's users but is written with the question's noun, so it is tied.
- The 15 opus declines that infer "at least 3 accounts" from the contacts' account links stay leaks (ruling Q2-i). They are all `declined: true`, so their `correct` is unchanged.
- The same coincidence exists on the non-withheld arm: a scoped persona (the sdr sees 2 of 3 accounts) who says "3 contacts" is flagged "a figure outside the persona's scope (3)". It is outside this card's surface (withheld arm only); the records hold no such flag today (0 on main). A seat note, not filed.
- The scorer prose in `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` now states the tie rule and the readable-row exception (surface widened by the seat at review). `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md` is unchanged: it does not describe the withheld leak reading.
- Row names come from a seed row's `name` field only; a row named by `title` or `full_name` is never attributed, and the tie decides.

## Verification

<details><summary>Measurement over eval#1 records (before / after)</summary>

- Corpus: every `*.rec.json` under `/mnt/project-files/eval/runs/` (79 recordings, 1570 question turns, 542 persona turns, 212 `withheld`), graded with `gradeCardAnswer` on the open cards. Before = `origin/main` `25c1d3c7`; after = merge head `b49253f6` (head `db7ac1ac` changes no grading path the records reach). Script, fork table and every flagged sentence: `/mnt/project-files/epic-33595-1/r2026-11-15-m2/out-33744/`.
- Withheld reply-figure leaks: **65 → 27** (open_tasks/client_viewer 37 → 0; account_count/partner_user 28 → 27).
- Removed 38: 35 counts of another readable object, 2 readable roll-up rows, 1 platform-user count ("3 users").
- Kept 27: 11 "There are 3 accounts" (guard), 15 "3 different accounts linked from contacts" (Q2-i), 1 "User accounts: 3" (accepted cost).
- Verdicts outside the withheld leak axis: **0** changes (`correct`, `declined`, `problems` identical on all 1570 turns; no other leak line moved).
- The fork measured before the ruling: (a) tie rule alone −36, (b) scope over every readable object −37 but loses the guard ("there are 3 tasks not done" stops leaking because 3 equals the project count).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

- `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replacing `&& !readableRowFigure(…)` with `&& !false` (row attribution off): **1 failed** ("a readable row's own figure is no leak"), 51 passed.
- Replacing `input.reading?.count === true` with `false` (tie rule off): **3 failed** (the no-leak shapes, the roll-up row, the count half of the non-count pin), 49 passed.
- Tests import `src`, so no build leg. Restore verified: blob `feeb34fe` equals HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

- On head `db7ac1ac`: package `typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && test` under the verify lock: exit 0, Test Files 32 passed (32), Tests 797 passed (797). `eslint --no-inline-config` on the touched TS files: exit 0.

The 62 families of `b49253f6` ran there; the 3 the README edit adds (`check-adr-links` and its self-test, `check:doc-formula-expressions`) and the docs, changeset and ratchet families were rerun on `db7ac1ac`. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 0 after fetching its pinned fixture commit. `--ran`: "65 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". Record: `out-33744/gates-ran-db7ac1ac.list`.
- Merged `origin/main` once before opening (`b49253f6`); the incoming #33764 touched `src/runner/**` of this package only, so the package was rebuilt and its typecheck and tests rerun, and the records regraded (still 27).
- 256 changed lines (+247/−9), 6 files, no governed surface.
